description:
`.github/workflows/docs.yml` has no `concurrency` block, and it is the only large PR workflow without one. Its path filter includes `benchbox/**`, `scripts/**`, and `Makefile`, so it runs on nearly every code PR push, and every superseded run finishes. A sampled PR run used about 19 runner-minutes (Sphinx build 14, linkcheck 2, visual regression 3). It ran on 662 PRs between 2026-08-23 and 2026-09-16.

Change: add a concurrency group that cancels in-progress `pull_request` runs for the same PR when a newer push arrives.
